description: In Azoia, where the Sintra hills meet the Atlantic, this two-bedroom home offers 110 m² of floor area across a 55 m² footprint. Timber, stone and light tones bring warmth to the interiors, while the terrace opens the house to the landscape and the Cabo da Roca horizon.

description: In Pego, Caldas da Rainha, this 7,973 m² country estate brings together a rural landscape, mature trees and ruins bearing an inscription from 1775. Plans for restoration and extension have been approved, with a 518.95 m² building footprint and the licence ready for payment — a rare opportunity to unite heritage, contemporary architecture and nature.
